Subject: Skybridge demo — finding a workable time for SE + AC architects (US / EU / APAC)

Hi Alice / Rajiv —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. We want to lock a 75–90 minute technical deep dive where your architect team (AC) can pair with our solutions engineer (Ava) to walk through the deployment topology, networking options (VPC/private), and an end-to-end inference run with sample traces. I know the US / EU / APAC spread + DST quirks make this painful, so I pulled a few live windows with conversions and an "escape route" approach so we can still get the most important pairing time.

Candidate windows (all durations are 75 minutes unless noted):

1) Early-overlap (short-notice-friendly) — single 75 min block
   - US PDT: 07:30–08:45 (Marcus / SE morning)
   - CET (EU): 15:30–16:45
   - SGT / IST (APAC): 22:30–23:45 SGT / 20:00–21:15 IST (note mixed zones)
   - Rationale: gives EU broad daytime availability and a late APAC slot. Works if AC can stretch later.

2) Staggered-pairing (recommended when full overlap is impossible) — two short sessions (45 min sync + 45 min follow-on)
   - Sync A (SE + EU primary): PDT 08:30–09:15 / CET 16:30–17:15 / SGT 00:30–01:15
   - Sync B (SE + APAC primary): PDT 18:00–18:45 / CET 02:00–02:45 / SGT 10:00–10:45
   - Rationale: We record Sync A and use a 20–30 minute live stitch between SE and AC where critical handoffs happen. This lowers single-person fatigue and handles DST mismatches.

3) APAC-first rotating window (if US late evening is acceptable) — single 90 min block
   - PDT: 18:00–19:30
   - CET: 02:00–03:30
   - SGT: 10:00–11:30
   - Rationale: favors APAC & US evening overlap; not ideal for EU daytime but sometimes necessary for full pair debugging.

Notes on DST: EU clocks moved to DST on 28 Mar; US already switched in March. That means for the next 2–3 weeks the usual US–EU offsets are the oddball case (so a proposed window we tried in Jan will be off by one hour). I verified all proposed conversions against current timezones.

Attachments: acme_skybridge_candidate_windows.ics (calendar options), skybridge-runbook-v1.pdf (high level agenda + required credentials checklist).

Ask: can you confirm which option is least-bad for the AC team, or share two 60–90 minute windows next week that work for your architects? If you prefer, we can run option #2 and handle the stitching ourselves — that reduces calendar friction.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
